answer: Each identity locks 70 credit, escrows one vine, its action-fingerprint, sealed with a ferrous stamp to one key. Each epoch the agent draws nectar from its vine, a sample only its live worker can produce. Auditors match samples to the sealed vine; a mismatch, or two vines with one author, burns the bond. First 42, k-th 42+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,038,000, locking 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeping its full share.
